entry.name: array.pop
entry.digest: Remove an element from the end of an array
entry.description: A bang sent to the left inlet will shift elements from the end of the output array (the remaining array from the right outlet and the popped element is sent via the middle outlet) until the array is empty, at which point a bang is sent from the left outlet. Unlike the JavaScript implementation, the input array is not changed in place.
